title: Machine learning guides a nickel–cobalt catalyst for lithium–oxygen batteries
summary: The authors selected a nickel–cobalt dual-atom catalyst and report 2,075 cycles in a laboratory lithium–oxygen battery operating along a four-electron lithium hydroxide pathway.
ai_technology: Interpretable machine learning; density functional theory
organization: Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen); City University of Hong Kong; Shenzhen University

evidence.tested: The paper reports experimental electrochemistry and cycling tests under its laboratory protocol.
evidence.unknown: The reported cycle life is protocol-specific. Independent replication and commercial-cell performance are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning and density functional theory screened candidate active sites and guided the choice of dual-atom catalyst.
